idea-plugin.name: Gemini CLI Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gemini CLI Companion for JetBrains IDEs

This extension enables seamless integration between Gemini CLI and JetBrains IDEs, providing:

  • Workspace Context: Automatic awareness of your workspace, active files, and cursor position
  • Native Diffing: View and edit Gemini's suggested changes directly in your IDE's diff viewer
  • Real-time Updates: Live context updates as you work

To use this extension, install Gemini CLI and run it from your IDE's integrated terminal.
